# Dysonswarm audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/dysonswarm-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set dysonswarm` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `breath.mp3` is cut from "Mask Breathing Sound" by Kodack, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Kodack/sounds/256519/.
- `hum.mp3` is cut from "S40-13 Alien hum or space ship interior.wav" by craigsmith, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/craigsmith/sounds/675339/.
- `sheet.mp3` is cut from "de rottende veerboot" by allthingssound, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/allthingssound/sounds/425183/.
- `radio.mp3` is cut from "Radio static" by LukaCafuka, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/LukaCafuka/sounds/760335/.
